verdict.rationale: Google Workspace ships AI features such as Gemini in Gmail, so a training-data privacy control is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a commitment or setting that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The Meet 'Take notes for me' admin settings are an adjacent AI-feature control, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
